data.name: User Data Processing Consent
data.description: This consent document outlines the terms under which user data may be collected, processed, stored, and shared for analytics and service improvement purposes. The user agrees to allow the organization to use anonymized data for research and marketing, while retaining the right to withdraw consent at any time through the provided user portal. The document follows the latest regulatory guidelines, including GDPR and CCPA, ensuring transparency and user control over personal information.
